save_multiplier_diagnosis.bottleneck: High commercial click intent without save-trigger prompts.
save_multiplier_diagnosis.pixie_graph_impact: Lack of saves prevents Pixie random walk graph clustering from broadcasting pins to adjacent users.
action_plan: Inject '📌 SAVE THIS PIN for later' prompt overlays in all future 2:3 graphics.
Switch 40% of future publishing to 4-slide native carousels (demonstrated 100% CTR on Small Apartment Hacks).
Route all links through Next.js Bridge Gateway (/p/[slug]) to ensure domain trust and eliminate spam throttle risk.
